title: Auspices

inlines.v: AU'SPICE, AU'SPICES, noun [Latin auspicium, of avis, a bird, and specio, to inspect.] 1. The omens of an undertaking, drawn from birds; the same as augury, which see. 2. Protection; favor shown; patronage; influence. In this sense the word is generally plural auspices
